meta.title: Quote selection (dsh-client-ui-quote)
meta.description: Select any sentence in the chat, a file preview or the terminal to quote it, Kimi-Code style: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to conversation and Side chat, the first two insert a DSH reference chip into the composer, and the third writes the quote into the composer of one independent side thread per conversation in the right sidebar without sending it (needs dsh-better-sidebar). Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things, and hovering a sent quote can jump back to its source.
